task.title: Adding a time synchronization recipient
task.shortdesc: The driver sends periodic BACnet time synchronization messages from the station to all defined time synchronization recipients (devices) or to UTC time synchronization recipients (devices), at the interval specified in the properties. This procedure documents how to add these recipients. This adds controllers to the list of devices whose time can be reset.

step.cmd: Expand ConfigDriversBacnetNetwork and double-click Local Device.
step.stepresult: The Local Device Property Sheet opens.

step.cmd: Scroll down to Time Synchronization Recipients.
Right-click this property and click ActionsaddElement.

choices.choice: To add a device as the recipient, select Device from the left-hand drop-down box, select the name of the device in the middle drop-down box, fill in the device ID (Object Id), and click OK.
To add the address of another location, select Address from the left-hand drop-down box (the window changes), fill in the Network Number and MAC Address, and click OK.

step.stepresult: The driver adds the recipient name under Time Synchronization Recipients.
